Chapter 627: Chapter 44 Treasure of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm (5000 words, Please subscribe)_2

Perhaps before this secret realm perished, Lin Yuan might have stepped into the ultimate domain?

“Treasure and heritage?”

Lin Yuan was slightly curious, his expression filled with anticipation.

The earthy yellow crystal was absorbed into his inner world, to be refined by the power of the world. Lin Yuan indeed found that it could not be refined successfully in a short time.

However, it probably wouldn’t take too long.

Based on the feeling this crystal gave Lin Yuan, once fully refined, Lin Yuan would become the ‘Dominion’ of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, possessing all ‘privileges’.

...

“First is the ‘Source of Xuanhuang’… also known as ‘Xuanhuang Crystal’ in the outside world.” The Six-Armed Silhouette had a slight flicker of thought, and as the heavens and the earth shifted, he brought Lin Yuan to a vast space.

“That mountain?”

Lin Yuan first noticed a small mountain in the distance.

The small mountain was earthy yellow, only a few hundred meters high and looked quite unremarkable.

But—

“Is this small mountain made up of Xuanhuang Crystals?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat shocked. In the outer world, a fist-sized piece of Xuanhuang Crystal could fetch a sky-high price of one hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

But now, the small mountain in front of him, several hundred meters high, was it all made up of Xuanhuang Crystals?

How much would that be worth in Cubic Universe Crystals? With the speed at which Lin Yuan’s thoughts moved, just a slight extrapolation allowed him to calculate that this small mountain was valued in the universe’s dimensions, in the trillions and quintillions of measures.

Trillions and quintillions… Not in civilization currency, nor universe currency, but in Universe Crystals.

The entire fortune of an Eighth Layer powerhouse might hover around ten thousand Cubic Universe Crystals, and a Ninth Rank powerhouse’s entire fortune wouldn’t exceed three hundred million at most.

Here the peak refers to those special Ninth Rank beings who have lived through lengthy eons.

And the Xuanhuang Crystals here were worth trillions and quintillions?

“Actually, these Xuanhuang Crystals were collected only after the indigenous lives of the secret realm had died of old age,” said the Six-Armed Silhouette, shaking his head, “and with the passage of time, a great part of the Xuanhuang Crystals has naturally dissipated.”

“Died of old age?”

Lin Yuan marveled in his heart.

Below the Supreme Beings, unless like the Stone Statue Shen Ji which are ‘puppets’ or ‘Artifact Spirits’, as long as they are lives, they all have a natural lifespan.

Only by achieving the ultimate can one be eternal.

“Are all of these mine?” Lin Yuan asked.

“All yours,” the Six-Armed Silhouette said with a smile.

Although Lin Yuan had not yet refined the Core of the Secret Realm, and hence not become the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, in the eyes of the Six-Armed Silhouette, Lin Yuan had already been chosen.

“I have a suggestion,” the Six-Armed Silhouette hesitated for a moment, then spoke.

“Please speak,” Lin Yuan immediately responded.

“These Xuanhuang Crystals, it’s best not to take them out in a short period,” the Six-Armed Silhouette said.

“The Xuanhuang Secret Realm, every time it opens, more than one Supreme Being tries to lock down the specific coordinates.”

“But where could they decipher the methods left by His Majesty?” the Six-Armed Silhouette scoffed, “Those Supreme Beings have always been wishing to obtain His Majesty’s heritage, but they have never been able to wish as they wished.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette implied something with his words.

Upon this declaration.

Lin Yuan immediately understood.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm had already been opened many times.

Each opening usually released a certain quantity of Xuanhuang Crystals, with not much variation in the amount.

If Lin Yuan, in a short period, took out the mountain-scale Xuanhuang Crystals to the outer world, and word got out.

It would inevitably attract the attention of all the major Peak Clans, wondering why this opening of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm released so many Xuanhuang Crystals?

Though unlikely, there would surely be suspicions among the Peak Clans about whether a Ninth Rank powerhouse had gained the approval of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, thus obtaining so many Xuanhuang Crystals in one go.

Once such speculation arose, all the Ninth Rank powerhouses who entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm during this period would have to be thoroughly scrutinized, with Lin Yuan being the most prominent among them.

Even if protected by Human Civilization, other Peak Clans couldn’t interfere, but within Human Civilization, there was a slight possibility that they would question Lin Yuan about this matter.

How would Lin Yuan respond then?

To lie? The high echelons of Human Civilization might not believe it.

To tell the truth? What if Human Civilization requested Lin Yuan to actively open the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, allowing human Evolvers to train there, or asked him to bring out the heritage and other gains from inside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?

Lin Yuan’s strength was still too weak to hold a treasure like the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, coveted even by Supreme Beings—a mismatch of power and responsibility.

Of course.

The above are just slightly possible scenarios.

More likely, Human Civilization would still value Lin Yuan’s potential and not chill the heart of the strongest genius in human history over the mere Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

But Lin Yuan would not allow himself to face such a choice of human nature.

“You can take out some Xuanhuang Crystals every hundred thousand years, spread it over several hundred to a thousand times; it should not attract too much attention,” the Six-Armed Silhouette said.

Every opening of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm released a portion of Xuanhuang Crystals, the quantity of which fluctuates, as long as they don’t increase too much in one go, so it wouldn’t cause too much of an impact.

“Understood,” Lin Yuan nodded.

At this moment, a desire for strength welled up in his heart; if he were a Supreme Being, there would be no need for secrecy. He could announce to all the major cosmic peak clans that the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was his own—what could others do then?

Without a real Supreme Being stationed in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, many Supreme Beings were unable to pry; with a Supreme Being stationed, which other Supreme Being would dare to object?

“There are also some weapons, secret treasures, minerals, plants, blood, bodies of special lives, and so on…” the Six-Armed Silhouette continued, “These are all belongings of Ninth Rank powerhouses who attempted to stay within the secret realm during its historical openings.”
